ValidationRule.description: Need_Further_Info_Notes__c must describe the specific issue when status is set to Need Further Info.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Need Further Info"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Need Further Info")), ISBLANK(Need_Further_Info_Notes__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: NFI Notes required: describe what info is missing, what the FM must do to resolve it, and whether photos are needed. The FM only sees this note — be specific.
